name: fire aura
desc:
At the start of each of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s turns, each creature within 5 feet of it takes 10 (3d6) fire damage, and flammable objects in the aura that aren't being worn or carried ignite.
A creature that touches the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 10 (3d6) fire damage.
